candidates.name: Band Pallof Press
candidates.cardText:
Band Pallof Press
Beginner
1
Place the band at an anchor point that is shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
2
Start with your fingers interlocked around the band and your fists connected to your chest.
3
Extend at the elbows pressing the band away from your body until your elbows are fully extended.

candidates.name: Band Wood Chopper
candidates.cardText:
Band Wood Chopper
Advanced
1
Anchor band at shoulder height. Stand sideways, feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend.
2
Grip band with both hands, arms extended.
3
Pull across body, rotating torso.

candidates.name: Band Side Bend
candidates.cardText:
Band Side Bend
Novice
1
Stand with band anchored low on one side, holding handle at hip.
2
Lean torso away from anchor, keeping hips and legs still.
3
Contract obliques to return upright, maintaining smooth control.

candidates.name: Band Pallof Press To Wood Chopper
candidates.cardText:
Band Pallof Press To Wood Chopper
Intermediate
1
Stand sideways to band, hold handle at chest, and brace your core.
2
Press arms straight forward, resisting rotation.
3
Rotate torso and pull band across body in a wood chopper motion, then return.
